confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not from live listings or menus. Figures reflect typical July peak-season Kyoto levels, so accommodation is the most seasonal and uncertain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.6955 value came from search summaries attributed to the RBA exchange rates page; the RBA daily table was not opened directly, and other snippets gave conflicting October figures, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other major Japanese visitor cities such as Osaka, Nara and Hiroshima, adjusted upward for Kyoto's higher summer accommodation premium.
